name: Test-link normal-position supervision
aliases: switchgear Switchgear test and commissioning interfaces
summary: Reports whether the selected test links have returned to their documented service positions.
description: Reports whether the selected test links have returned to their documented service positions. A test interface separates measurement, command and indication paths so their behavior can be checked in the documented test configuration. The test boundary must show which real equipment outputs remain enabled.

In a switchgear relay panel, test links can separate a protective relay from the trip coils while maintaining the specified current-transformer secondary arrangement. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Test-link status contacts” at the input and “Normal-position indication” at the output. A healthy indication does not certify completed commissioning.

Trace the source and destination on each side of the test boundary.
